runtime: UE 5.7.4 Development Win64, D3D11, 1280x720, sound disabled
verified: Two batches of 24 distinct world postcards are collected through real Hyper focus and E input, then transferred through Slate gamepad navigation/confirmation in the native UI.

The unchanged 8x6 cabin contains 48 real AGIS items. Battery transfer returns a visible No-space notice while preserving its source container, payload, receipts, campaign generation and world pickup active/hidden/collision states.
Explicit Save and clean UI quit precede a fresh executable process. Actual Continue restores the same campaign, byte-identical complete provider payload and 97 receipts.
Full-cabin refusal repeats after relaunch. Returning one postcard to the backpack frees one cell, which still cannot hold the 1x2 battery; this second refusal also conserves state.

Returning a second postcard through the UI frees enough space for battery transfer. The battery is retrieved through the UI, the fuse is collected through Hyper, and radio repair/acknowledgement/save complete.

All 48 postcards remain: two in the backpack and 46 in storage. Both critical parts are consumed, their world pickups remain collected, the final ledger has 103 receipts, and the final quit sequence exits cleanly.
